war_summary: War 139, day 89, no winner yet (30 victory towns required). The map is heavily polarized: many hexes are fully owned by one side with near-zero current combat, while fighting is concentrated in a handful of contested fronts. The heaviest active pressure is in Callahans Passage (~1k casualties/2h per side), Olavis Wake (~1.1k/2h), Dead Lands (~850/2h, warden-tilted losses), Speaking Woods (~750/2h), Onyx (~600/2h, evenly split at 3-3), and Clahstra (~880/2h). Base-flip activity in the last 24h clusters in Oarbreaker (26 events, ongoing as of 07:20Z), Mooring County (20 events), Clahstra (19), Stlican Shelf (20, though its last ~6h show sharp cooling after a big fight), Onyx (14), Endless Shore (8), Olavis Wake (8), plus smaller skirmishes at Tempest Isle, Morgens Crossing, Stema Landing, and Palantine Berm. Casualty rates across all hot zones show the same pattern: a large spike roughly 2-6h ago now cooling in the most recent hour, with enlistment inflows accelerating again — consistent with a lull between pushes rather than front collapse. Key uncertainties: only ~7h of event history is available; several high-casualty hexes (Callahans, Olavis, Speaking Woods) report zero base events despite massive casualties, so whether that fighting threatens strategic bases is unknown; and recent-hour cooling could mean either an operational pause or a completed push whose ownership effects have not yet been logged.
